topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't believe this. All that planning, all those whispers behind my back, the cryptic messages and the carefully avoided eye contact—just to end in nothing. They said it was going to be a night to remember, but now it’s just another empty promise. I should have known better than to get my hopes up. I’m not even sure why I bothered. It’s not like they care anyway. Now I’m left here with nothing to show for it, just an echo of what could have been. I guess I’ll have to find my own way to fill this void.
